work_item: B06 ordinary CLI bounded calculation sequences: scheduler namespace correction and whole-operand quantity references
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Sealed sequence input -> unique Core -> actual upstream exact values and artifact consumption -> scheduler observations -> exact rendered output and authorized local file receipt, typed stops and retained versions
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
version_boundary: Input grammar, sealed MeaningIR, parser revision, stored schemas and public result/graph artifact schemas are unchanged. Core scheduler key translation and executor quantity-context validation are corrected. Existing identity retries retain their saved result; recomputation requires a fresh input identity/version. This evidence uses explicit version 2.
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

baseline_defect.observed: Referenced scalar and mixed-length sequences SUSPEND/UNKNOWN with EXECUTION_ERROR: PREREQUISITE_SET_MISMATCH. An independent two-step no-reference control COMMITs with final 7/2. Original requests and complete stored results were checked through separate inspect.
baseline_defect.cause: Core supplied raw consumed step IDs to Scheduler.observe, while GoalNode.requires used sequence-{id} node IDs.
baseline_defect.boundary: Empty returned dependencies on this unexpected error do not prove that no step artifact was physically stored. No wrong quantity COMMIT is attributed to this published base.

unpublished_intermediate_diagnostic.stage: Uncommitted and unpublished namespace-only correction; no quantity-context guard
unpublished_intermediate_diagnostic.controls: Scalar 2@{u}+1 with upstream 3 remains INVALID_EXPRESSION due to parenthesized substitution. A unit-prefix probe also suspends under the intermediate calculator; it is not counted as a wrong COMMIT.
unpublished_intermediate_diagnostic.causal_limit: The original published base blocked references at scheduler observation. These five wrong results were exposed only after that first private correction and are retained as intermediate diagnostic evidence.

correction: Keep raw step IDs in step artifacts and raw declared/actual set checking; map consumed prerequisite keys into sequence-{id} only at the Core-to-scheduler observation boundary.

Retain parenthesized canonical rational substitution. For canonical quantities, track the inserted byte ranges and map them through the same NFKC/operator normalization as calculate. Require each insertion to occupy the complete existing unit-grammar operand, allowing one source unary sign. Reuse the exact existing unit addition/subtraction regex; numeric/exponent/ratio prefixes, unit suffixes and other operators stop with CALCULATION_REFERENCE_CONTEXT.

tests_and_route.route_method: Actual minidora-rust --json child processes and fresh stores; read returned step/report/graph/goal/compute/content/render/file artifacts with actor/case-authorized Store::get_bytes and digest verification. Separate inspect verifies original request and complete result.

review_cli_run.change: Add whole final calculation equality with the final step artifact and original-request equality on the late permission stop. Product source is unchanged.

tests_and_route.count_boundary: 136 CLI-test requests include six exact retries across two passes. The diagnostic replay adds ten exact retries and ten new versions. Inspect and pure component/scheduler calls are not execute requests.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; focused tests plus workspace all-target compile/lint. No full B02/B06/R2 acceptance claim.

command_results.cause_and_resolution: New test initially referenced an error-code helper in a different test module. A local test closure replaced it before any runtime test ran; subsequent all-target checks and lint passed. Product compilation did not fail.

route_observations.route: Scalar references and exact artifact/graph maps
route_observations.evidence: Japanese/lowercase/mixed-case English headers with LF/CRLF, blank/indented/trailing-space lines, fullwidth numeric text, negative rationals, repeated references, explicit first-occurrence requires order differing from lexical order, an unused independent step, and minimum/maximum 1/16-step chains. Every step source span, relative reference range and occurrence is checked against original UTF-8; actual parent exact value and SHA are checked. Raw step IDs remain distinct from prefixed scheduler keys. Compute consumes all declared steps including the unused step.

Seven authored families through three headers: mixed-length multi-stage conversion, rational lengths, scientific notation, source unary minus, repeated fullwidth-plus operands and existing literal unit labels e/m/1e. Actual inserted values, parent hashes, final result and source/graph maps are checked. Identical unit labels retain the existing string-based contract; no general dimension validation is established.

N step dependencies plus one sequence report; exact nodes/observed hashes and every per-node consumed map; required-graph/GoalContract agreement with sealed intent, budget, permissions and output path; compute artifact contains final calculation, actual display units, evidence and dependencies; saved content/render artifacts equal returned objects; final calculation including steps equals the last actual step artifact. Output insertion offsets are not supplied and are not claimed.

Parser failures preserve no completed step. Arithmetic/context failures preserve only the first successful step and no later step/report/final calculation/render/file receipt. Budget N+2 and deadline zero stop before calculation; report evidence budget one byte retains both completed step artifacts but no report or final calculation. Stored typed-step enumeration checks actual progress, not only dependency-array length. These cases remain SUSPEND/UNKNOWN.

WRITE_PERMISSION_MISSING occurs after actual computation/adoption/render: SUSPEND/COMPUTED, final 10, three step/report dependencies, content plan and RENDERED observation survive; execution graph ref is null, receipts/actions empty and no file exists. Original request and complete result persist.

route_observations.route: Saved-result explanation and explicit input versions
route_observations.evidence: Initial sequence produces 10; exact retry returns the original. Actual follow-up explanation links/copies its calculation and context result ID. Explicit version 2 produces 14 with new artifacts and retains the old complete result. A later version-1 retry still returns the original without replacing the current version-2 projection.

route_observations.route: Authorized local file effect and exact retry
route_observations.evidence: At exact N+4 action budget, actual file bytes equal displayed UTF-8 text and the CONFIRMED receipt target/hash/observed bytes. The execution graph consumes the stored receipt. Exact retry returns the same result with unchanged bytes/mtime and one action identity/receipt. This scoped observation does not establish general physical or remote exactly-once behavior.

known_limits: These authored calculations are scoped QC, not an independent held-out B02/B06 acceptance population or general natural-language goal decomposition.

Quantity references are restricted to complete operands in the existing binary unit addition/subtraction grammar. Single-quantity identity, nested quantities, dimensional multiplication/division and broader physical dimensions remain unsupported.
Full resource/failure matrices, timeout-at-each-step injection, long-history/hostile concurrency, all inherited quantity contracts and broader task-quality populations remain unverified.
Full workspace runtime regression, frozen Python tests, external LIVE, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, remote delivery, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.
